title: Spatial delocalization of cold oscillators in hollow-core fibers
summary: Trapped particles in hollow-core fibers enable long-range sensing, though advanced control of their in-fiber motion, such as multimodal cooling and squeezing, remains challenging. Here, we present optical interference-based adaptive techniques for controlling the motion of a fringe-trapped silica nanoparticle inside a fiber. After feedback-cooling its axial and radial motion, we induce axial delocalization (position anti-squeezing) via two complementary approaches.
